title: Step-10 sweep transfers the contract's ENTIRE payment-token balance to msg.sender with no nudgeSize or qualifies gate
description: `uint256 remaining = paymentToken.balanceOf(address(this))` refunds the whole balance rather than the caller's own unspent budget, on any `count == 1` call with empty reward arrays. Whenever a dispatcher returns its own prime token to the batch minter, the pot can leave ONLY through this door — the §4.1 guard simultaneously makes that same asset un-listable as a reward token.
impact: An accumulated nudge pot (protocol-directed incentive funds — SYA nudgeSplit drip plus the dispatcher's per-mint cut) is extractable in full by any count==1 caller with empty reward arrays, bypassing the nudgeSize=40 gate entirely. On a self-sinking wiring the qualifying mint is also free.
attackPath: 1. A dispatcher returns its own primeToken to the batch minter, so the pot asset == the payment token.
2. The §4.1 guard makes that asset UN-LISTABLE as a reward token, so the legitimate nudge claimer cannot take it (proven: test_QualifyingBatcherCannotListThePotAsset).
3. Any caller submits batchMint(count=1, recipient, paymentAmount, [], []).
4. Step 10 refunds `paymentToken.balanceOf(address(this))` — the WHOLE balance, not the caller's unspent budget — to msg.sender.
5. The pot leaves. batchMint returns totalPaid == 0, so the transaction reads as a free batch.
likelihood: Mechanic is permissionless and cost-free and has three independent executed witnesses. Present exposure is ZERO: RatchetBatchNFTMinter holds 0 USDC / 0 USDS / 0 ETH, archive-confirmed 0 at the block before the fix, and NudgeRatchet.batchMinter() has been REPOINTED.
assumptions: A payment-token balance accumulates on the contract. That is the normal steady state whenever a dispatcher's primeToken is also its donated asset.
externalRequirements: One setBatchMinter call, or any USDC airdrop to 0x81896F48…, re-arms it instantly. The old instance is deliberately retained and still live with USDC as its swept payment token.
justification: SETTLED AT MEDIUM BY D-22 ON LIVE READ-ONLY CHAIN EVIDENCE — carried forward unchanged, not re-litigated. Not High: no funds are exposed now and none were ever lost this way (the self-refund returned funds within the same transaction, so no inter-block pot ever existed). Not Low: the un-gated sweep at :381-383 is unchanged in code, the old instance is retained and live, and re-arming is a single owner call or an airdrop away. This is textbook C4 Medium — value leak with stated assumptions and external requirements.
